Name: Various Paths for CustomPaths
Author: LowProfileDog
Description:
[b]NOTE:  There is currently a bug in CustomPaths that makes it possible to manually stack different types of paths together, converting them all into one type.  Please be careful with your inventory until this is fixed by Entoarox.[/b]

Too many cool paths and not enough vanilla ones to replace?  Not anymore!  This is a content pack for CustomPaths that contains a selection of path replacements converted to its expanded image format and added to the game as new paths.  All are sold by Marnie for 10g each to avoid further crowding Pierre and Robin's shop inventories.  The seller, as well as price, can be changed in paths.json (note that as of CustomPaths 1.14, in-game price is double what you put in paths.json).

Paths currently added by this content pack are:

[list]
[*][b]Light Grass[/b] (Natural Paths by MouseyPounds)
[*][b]Dark Grass[/b] (Natural Paths by MouseyPounds)
[*][b]Light Dirt[/b][b] [/b](Natural Paths by MouseyPounds)
[*][b]Dark Dirt[/b] (Natural Paths by MouseyPounds)
[*][b]Sand﻿ [/b](Natural Paths by MouseyPounds)
[*][b]Straw[/b][b] [/b](Natural Paths by MouseyPounds)
[*][b]Transparent[/b][b] [/b](inspired by the one from Natural Paths by MouseyPounds)
[*][b]Stream [/b](Stream Path by thequeenofbees) (seasonal recolor by me)
[*][b]Brick-Lined Gravel [/b](Garden Paths by CNCooper)
[*][b]*NEW* Straw Floor Without Straw[/b] (Eemie's Path Edits by Eemiestardew)
[*][b]*NEW* Dark Cobblestone [/b](Eemie's Path Edits by Eemiestardew)
[/list]
In progress:

[list]
[*][i]Shadow [/i]﻿(inspired by the one from Natural Paths by MouseyPounds)
[*][i]Sidewalk [/i](vanilla assets)
[*][i]Concrete Slab[/i] (vanilla assets)
[*][i]Purple Crystal Cobblestone[/i] (New paths by neocores and naggums)
[*][i]Galaxy Void[/i] (New paths by neocores and naggums)
[/list][list]
[/list]Snow and ice overrides from Natural Paths are also included.

Feel free to request more.
